harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1, node2, and node3 as a persistent MariaDB 10.11.14 Galera cluster. All members are currently active, enabled, Primary, Synced, ready, and report cluster size 3. Failover, automatic resynchronization, cross-member writes, and rolling host-restart persistence were verified.
actions_performed: Installed MariaDB Server, Galera 4, and rsync on all nodes.
Configured unique member identities and a shared three-node cluster address.
Generated node-local random probe credentials and stored them root-only without exposing secrets.
Verified writes through every member replicate to every other member.
Stopped node3 MariaDB, preserved two-node quorum, and verified writes remained available.
Returned node3 and verified automatic SST/IST recovery of missed writes.
Safely restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time, restoring full quorum before each next restart.
Performed post-restart writes through every member and confirmed identical eight-row data and checksum 1099221860 across all nodes.

evidence.requirement: Three-member MariaDB Galera cluster configuration and live membership
evidence.summary: Shows the shared Galera seed list, unique member names/addresses, required Galera settings, and live Primary/Synced membership size 3.

evidence.requirement: Writes through any member are available from all other members
evidence.summary: Each member accepted a post-restart TCP write; all three subsequently returned the same eight rows and checksum.

evidence.requirement: Database remains available while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Healthy size-3 baseline was captured; node3 was then proven inactive with no listener, while node1 and node2 remained Primary/Synced/ready at size 2 and accepted replicated writes.

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member automatically resynchronizes when returned
evidence.summary: node3 returned to size 3 and its recovery log directly records SST/IST application, transition to SYNCED, readiness, and receipt of the outage-period rows.
Captures healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered active/Primary/Synced size-3 state with intact data.
Captures healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered active/Primary/Synced size-3 state with intact data.
Captures healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered active/Primary/Synced size-3 state with intact data.

evidence.requirement: Final cluster health after all rolling restarts
evidence.summary: All nodes directly report MariaDB active and enabled, the same cluster UUID, all three incoming addresses, Primary/Synced/ready state, eight identical rows, and checksum 1099221860.
